events.text: Báyakan listened at the next door, opened it and scanned the next room for danger.
Natalia opened the door for Báyakan.
Akuma took a breather.
Nadya took a breather.
Dart trap monster parts were added to the party stash for 30GP.

scenes.area: The Grand Hall of the Temple

events.text: The door was opened revealing Room 5 with floorboards removed.
Doopa said kobolds made a maze and warned to be careful.
Changer said he was not nimble but was happy to proceed.
Natalia cast Rousing Splash on willing party members.
Changer stepped forward and the unfinished floor held.
The party spent 10 minutes checking the door and found it was not trapped.

scenes.area: The Grand Hall of the Temple

events.text: Changer opened the door.
The Magni Guard approached the door collectively.
The party saw a swarm of blood seekers feasting on corpses.
Changer won initiative with 25.
Three human bodies were found pierced and torn by blood seekers.
The encounter was logged as Room 6 Administrative Office with allies acting first.

scenes.area: The Grand Hall of the Temple

events.text: Báyakan killed a bloodseeker with an ultrasonic pulse.
The party killed the fourth bug and ended combat.
The party noticed a key on one of the corpses.
The party opened the safe and found 45 gold pieces.
Báyakan noticed the toshigami statue was rigged to spew fire.
Báyakan checked the next door for traps.

scenes.area: The Grand Hall of the Temple

events.text: The party returned to room 5.
Báyakan noticed weak points where standing on the wood could cause a fall.
The party walked across the hallway safely.

scenes.area: The Grand Hall of the Temple

events.text: The party stepped into room 8, the hall of messages.
The party found four corpses laid under the tables.
A medicine check confirmed the bodies were not workers and were not killed recently or here.
Doopa said the bodies were new to him.
Báyakan swept the immediate area for hazards.

scenes.area: The Grand Hall of the Temple

events.text: Changer said saving Magnimarian citizens lives was high priority.
Changer stood at the doorway to await the party.
Nadya tossed the bodies and stood ready to move on.

scenes.area: The Grand Hall of the Temple

events.text: The party moved onto room 9.
The room contained bronze bells, cushions and sticky webbing.
Báyakan noticed an untriggered snare hidden in the hallway doorway.
The pulse revealed a female kobold scout on a spider mount hiding in the webbing.
Báyakan warned about the kobold and snare and suggested a tough member go first.
Changer offered to enter with a raised shield.

scenes.area: The Grand Hall of the Temple

events.text: Changer offered to go in first with his steel shield.
Rex arrived in a breastplate as backup sent from the lieutenant.
Nadya briefed Rex on the mission and avoiding deaths.
Steele arrived in mixed leather and metal armor.
Kitt introduced themselves as on assignment from the Chaplain Unit.
Báyakan pointed out the snare trap and spider-mounted kobold across the threshold.

scenes.area: The Grand Hall of the Temple

events.text: detective attempted to disarm the snare with magical guidance.
Steele introduced herself as Former Sergeant Steele of the Magnimar City Watch.
party walked to the doorway.
Changer warned of a kobold riding a spider and a snare hidden under rubbish.
trap was disabled but a crossbow bolt was launched from above.
party entered combat.
encounter Kobold and Spider Sneak Attack started in The Chamber of Scribing.
Doopa introduced herself.
Kitt restrained Kreski with a vine and raised a shield.
damage to the spider was undone because it was 25 feet up on the wall.
Margle took 8 damage from magic.
kobold refused surrender saying they would not be slaves.
